name: @arcanea/claw
description: AI-powered media pipeline: scan, classify, score, process, upload, social. 8 skills, 11 MCP tools. Works standalone, with OpenClaw, or as MCP tools for Claude Code.
long_description: Complete media processing pipeline for creative world-builders. Scans directories for images/video/audio, classifies by character and element using heuristics and AI vision, scores aesthetic quality (0-100) across 5 dimensions with Gemini Vision, resizes to 6 platform-optimized variants, uploads hero-tier assets to Vercel Blob and gallery-tier to Supabase Storage, and generates social media posts with AI captions and hashtags.

changelog.0.1.0: Initial release: 8 skills, 11 MCP tools, OpenClaw/NanoClaw/Claude Code support
